title: METTL3-mediated mA modification of DNMT1 enhances ovarian cancer progression.
snippet: High-grade serous ovarian carcinoma (HGSOC), the most lethal subtype of ovarian cancer, is often diagnosed at advanced stages and remains associated with poor clinical outcome.
